environment.description: ECS Fargate task running in a VPC with the gRPC downstream service (Envoy-based mesh). The Lambda function URL that feeds the SQS queue is configured with AuthType=NONE, allowing any internet caller to POST webhook payloads with arbitrary HTTP headers. These headers are mapped 1:1 to SQS MessageAttributes by the Lambda function. The downstream gRPC service trusts metadata headers prefixed with 'x-' for internal routing decisions including x-envoy-original-dst-host and x-internal-auth-principal.

config.network: VPC with public subnets, no WAF
